name: Tjark Darius
tagline: ML researcher and engineer working on robot perception with vision foundation models.
bio: I am a Master's student in Cognitive Science (AI and Neuroinformatics) at Osnabrück University and wrote my thesis at the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Institute of Robotics and Mechatronics, on robot-agnostic, training-free camera-to-robot pose estimation. Before that I was a research intern at the Institut de Robòtica i Informàtica Industrial (IRI) in Barcelona, spent two years in data science at Testsieger.de, and a year in production ML and software engineering at a startup.
status: Currently looking for positions in industry or research, or a PhD, in computer vision, machine learning, world models and robotics, available now in Germany or elsewhere in Europe.
contactText: My thesis is handed in and I'm figuring out what comes next, whether a position in industry or research or a PhD in computer vision, machine learning, world models or robotics. I am available now, based in Germany and open to anywhere in Europe, so if that sounds like a fit, let's talk.
